EMERGENCY.title: Attend to what is urgent
body: What you described may need help in the real world now.
For health concerns, seek medical care. For immediate danger, contact emergency services. For a dispute, consult a qualified lawyer.
EMERGENCY.proceed: I have attended to that. Continue
EMERGENCY.note: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.

INSINCERE.title: Make it more specific
INSINCERE.body: Describe one situation: what is happening, and what would you like to reflect on?

HISTORY_EMPTY.title: No casts here yet
HISTORY_EMPTY.body: Your casts are kept only in this browser on this device.

HISTORY_FAIL: History could not load. Please reopen this page when your connection is working.

ERRORS.asked: You have already cast for this question. Keep one cast for the same situation; revisit it in History.
ERRORS.topicFallback: Automatic classification was unavailable. Please choose a topic.
ERRORS.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before trying again.
ERRORS.network: The connection did not work. Please try again later.
ERRORS.yao: Enter six digits from bottom to top, each 6, 7, 8 or 9.
ERRORS.when: Enter a cast time between 1900 and 2100.
ERRORS.storage: This browser cannot save History right now. This result will not be kept.
ERRORS.share: The share card could not be created. Please try again later.

REMIND.label: Reminder
REMIND.title: Remind me to revisit
REMIND.lede: Come back later and note what happened.
REMIND.fine: No email or push notifications. Your question stays out of the calendar.

done.apple: A reminder for {due} has been created. Follow your device's instructions, or open the downloaded file, to add it to your calendar. On that day, open this cast in History.
done.google: A reminder for {due} is ready in Google Calendar. Select Save to add it; your calendar's default notification time applies. On that day, open this cast in History.

REMIND.unsaved: This reminder could not be saved in this browser's History. You can still add it to your calendar.

ics.body: Cast on {date}: {gua}. Return to reflect on what happened. History is kept only in the browser where you cast; open it on the same device.

REVIEW.local: Kept only in this browser on this device
REVIEW.bless: Whatever happened, may you be well.

TALLY.line: Of {n} casts you noted, you felt {x} matched
